Hi Marta — thanks for the file, that helps a lot. TL;DR: start Compact + burst credits, upgrade to Throughput Plus if sustained baseline grows; we can preserve pilot credits on upgrade and offer a clear stepdown path.

Details:
- Compact is optimized for variable traffic: lower base unit price, good prefix/KV caching, and allows burst credits (we throttle to keep latency SLOs but allow short high-volume spikes). It’s commonly used as a pilot plan because it minimizes committed spend.
- Throughput Plus gives you dedicated slices and higher sustained throughput with predictable p99 latency — ideal when baseline becomes predictable.

Proration / stepdown:
- Upgrades are immediate and we pro-rate the remaining month based on list price differences; any one-time pilot credits you’ve accepted stay on the account and apply to the upgraded plan.
- If you downgrade within the same billing period we do not retroactively reclaim consumed credits — instead we provide a stepdown credit calculation applied as a credit to the next invoice (not cash-back). For multi-month reserved purchases we can create an amortized credit schedule so you don’t lose value when experimenting.

Feature guardrails suggestion: for the 3-month pilot (canary in us-west) I recommend:
1) Compact + burst credits (pilot allocation: 3 GPU-hrs/day burst pool)
2) Enable streaming + function/tool calling on a single route; defer global KV cache until after we validate latency with a 5% traffic slice.
3) Add monitoring alerting (token-cost delta + p99 latency) and a 10% threshold that triggers an upgrade review.

I’ve attached a one-page MAP template showing a sample timeline and trigger points. Next step: if that looks good I’ll pull in Ben to confirm pricing and a pilot concession.

Sergio Alvarez

Hi Marta — happy to jump in on price/credits. We can offer the following commercial terms for the 3-month pilot:
- 12% list discount on the first 12 months if you convert to an annual Throughput Plus commitment after the pilot.
- Pilot concession: $7k platform credit applied to invoices during the 3-month pilot (covers burst costs).
- Stepdown protection: if you need to downgrade within 90 days of upgrade, we’ll apply an amortized account credit equal to the unused portion of the committed delta (subject to a standard admin fee).

If you want a firmer number we’ll need to map expected tokens/throughput from the CSV — happy to take that offline with your finance lead.
